learning_outcomes.text: Comprehend the languages spoken in the world and the place of Turkish language among them.
Learn Turkish culture, customs and traditions exactly and be accepted in the society.
Improve national language and use it in better way.
Use science and knowledge by improving mothertongue.

syllabus_topics: Content and aim of course of Turkish Language
Language. (Language- nation relationship/ language- culture relationship)
All languages in the world. How basic Turkish Language is amongst other languages.
According to the language families in terms of basics for structure language groups.
The historical periods of Turkish Language. The historical periods of Turkish written language.
Old Turkish- Middle Turkish- New Turkish- Modern Turkish( up to date).
Today`s condition of Turkish Language and the areas of expansion.
The term of culture and civilization.Different types of of culture.
Syntax- The specialities of word groups.
